# 希可儿 · deepseek-mate
**A 3D desktop companion (桌宠) for DeepSeek Harness.** Install the plugin and 希可儿 appears in the Harn
ess Web UI, sitting on the chat input box. She breathes, looks at your cursor, reacts while the agen
t thinks, mouths the streamed reply, and can move out to your real desktop to sit on the top edge of
any window or the taskbar.
> **Naming.** The project/repository is **deepseek-mate**; the plugin package id is **`dsh-plugin-wh
ale-mate`** (kept unchanged so existing installs, config keys and stored settings keep working). The
character is **希可儿** (Xikeer).
中文文档 · Changelog · Asset licences · Contributing
## What she does
| Scenario                                  | Behaviour
| Idle                                      | Breathes, blinks, swings her legs, follows the mouse w
ith her eyes and head. Occasionally stretches, walks around, sits on the edge, or plays a small moti
on. After 3 minutes without activity she dozes off.

|
| You send a message                        | Nods to acknowledge it.

|
| DeepSeek is thinking                      | Hand on ch
in, with a "…" bubble.

|
| DeepSeek replies
| Her mouth moves in sync with the streamed text; the bubble shows the latest part of the
reply, then the opening of the reply once it finishes.

|
| A request
fails                           | Sad face, shakes her head, and the bubble explains why (for exampl
e, "no API key configured").

|
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements
- **DeepSeek Harness** — the official Desktop app (recommended) or `dsh web`, version `0.2.1` or new

er.
- **OS** — Windows 10/11, macOS, or Linux (X11). Desktop mode has the best window tracking on Wi

ndows; see Desktop mode.
- **Node.js 22+** only if you build from source or run the test suite. Inst

alling the plugin needs no toolchain.
- No Unity, no Blender, no separate application. Desktop mode
downloads its own Electron runtime on first use (or reuses one you already have).
## Installation
### Install sources
The **添加插件 (Add plugin)** dialog accepts three kinds of source:
| Source                | Example
| Notes                                       |
| npm package name      | `dsh-plugin-whale-mate@0.6.3`

| published on npm as `dsh-plugin-whale-mate` |
| GitHub repository URL | `https://
github.com/mymde/deepseek-mate.git#v0.6.3` or `github:mymde/deepseek-mate#v0.6.3` | this repository,

pinned to a tag            |
| absolute local path   | `/absolute/path/to/deepseek-mate` or a `.tgz
`                                              | offline installs and development            |
All three forms work. Pin a version or a tag (`@0.6.3`, `#v0.6.3`) so that reinstalling is reproduci
three forms work. Pin a version or a tag (`@0.6.3`, `#v0.6.3`) so that reinstalling is reproducible.
## How it works

- **Host side (`lib/index.js`)**
- serves the `public/` engine and model under `/whale-mate/` behind

Harness's own login fence (unauthenticated requests get a 401);
- registers the three `pet_*` tools

(they only acknowledge);
- mounts the desktop-mode routes and forwards validated commands to the ov

erlay.
- **Desktop overlay (`lib/desktop.js`, `desktop/`)**
- `lib/desktop.js` finds or downloads th
e runtime, starts `desktop/app.cjs` with a Node IPC channel (or runs the overlay in-process), and re

lays page → overlay messages through `POST /whale-mate/desktop/send` after validating them;
- `deskt
op/main.cjs` opens one transparent window over the work area of the display Harness is on, serves `o
verlay.html`, `pet.js` and the model from a random loopback port, toggles click-through from the pet
's per-pixel hit test (Windows/macOS) or sets an input shape around her (Linux), and polls the OS cu

rsor;
- on the official Windows Desktop, `desktop/harness-window.cjs` uses Koffi to read only the wi
ndow of the shell PID that launched the official Host (DWM visible-frame bounds, physical pixels con

verted to Electron DIP, polled at 50 ms). No other application is a perch;
- on Web / non-Windows th
e page reports `window.screenX/Y`, size and visibility every 200 ms; this fallback has no native tra

cking guarantees.
- **Browser side (`client/client.js`)** — a hand-written DSH client module (no bui
ld step at install time). It loads `public/pet.js` and follows the session in the main view through

the `sessions` service; live text, running state and `tool/call` events drive the pet directly.
- **

Engine (`src/pet/`, bundled to `public/pet.js` with three.js and three-vrm)**
- overlay: a transpare

nt `position:fixed` layer with a per-pixel hit test;
- pose system: locomotion, gesture layers, look

-at and root motion blended and smoothed onto every bone;
- physics: 70 spring bones added at runtim

e for hair, skirt and tail;
- face: emotion blending, random blinking, and lip sync driven by the te

or hair, skirt and tail;
- face: emotion blending, random blinking, and lip sync driven by the text.
